claims.claim: Body, engine n suspension for all model of honda, acura n toyota cars n suvs
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows a motorcycle/scooter front headlight assembly; no car body/engine/suspension parts are shown.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: the headlight may not fit the buyer’s exact motorcycle/scooter model (mounting points/shape may differ).
risks.proof: A photo/clip showing the headlight’s mounting tabs/holes aligned with the buyer’s specific motorcycle/scooter front cowl, or the exact part number/vehicle model written on the unit/box.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic/possibly non-fitting headlight assembly (higher chance of return/unsuitable fit).

risks.risk: Function risk: the lens may look intact but the bulb/LED, reflector, wiring, or internal electronics may be faulty.
risks.proof: A short video of the headlight turned on (low/high beam if applicable) plus a close-up of the connector/wiring and reflector condition.

risks.risk: Hidden damage risk: mounting tabs could be broken, or there could be internal moisture/condensation not visible from the single angle.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of all mounting points/tabs from multiple angles and a clip showing the lens from the side for any looseness; also check for fogging inside when powered on.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged/needs mounting repair.

risks.risk: Missing parts risk: brackets, wiring harness, bulb/ballast/driver, or turn-signal components may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of everything included laid out (bulb/driver/connector/brackets) and a checklist of included items.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as headlight assembly only, with missing accessories assumed possible.

risks.risk: Condition risk: lens haze, micro-cracks, or scratches may not be obvious in the photo but affect value.
risks.proof: A close-up under bright light showing the lens surface (front and edges) and any scratches/haze.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case cosmetic condition consistent with used parts.

proof_requests: Send a video showing the headlight working (and turn-signal if present) with the connector visible.
Send close-ups of all mounting tabs/holes from multiple angles to confirm fit.
Provide the exact motorcycle/scooter make/model compatibility (or part number) written on the unit/box.
Show what is included in the package (bulb/LED/driver, wiring harness, brackets) laid out clearly.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a motorcycle/scooter front headlight assembly with an intact-looking lens, so it can be priced at its worst-case used/untested scenario; seller’s car-part claims are not supported by the shown item.
